A_signal.p_rationale: With p == 1 the utility of an itemset is driven purely by signal strength and by how often the WAPs co-occur. This is the control condition of the ablation.

B_discriminative.p_formula: p(i) = max(I(A_i;Y), 1e-6) / max_j I(A_j;Y), with Y = BUILDINGID_FLOOR and I estimated from the joint histogram over 6 signal states
B_discriminative.p_rationale: External utility is read as 'how much knowing this AP's state tells us about the floor we are on'. This is the information-gain criterion the AP selection literature already uses, inserted into the HUIM utility slot.

C_rare_discriminative.p_formula: p(i) proportional to I(A_i;Y) * log(N/(1+support_i)), normalised to (0,1]
C_rare_discriminative.p_rationale: Tests whether down-weighting ubiquitous APs - which are detected everywhere and therefore separate nothing - changes the selected AP set. Optional third arm of the ablation.
